verdict: A very close, well-placed rebuild whose main gaps are Inter standing in for SF Pro and card shadows clipped at the feed's edges, built as a cleanly named auto-layout tree with real components but no shared styles and some spacer hacks.

top_defects.what: Inter instead of SF Pro: wider glyphs and different shapes everywhere ('Community', 'Footballeur français', 'Card hidden' run 5-10% wider); 'Which came first?' and 'Today' heavier (Inter 700 vs SF semibold/bold)

top_defects.where: 'Card hidden' banner, Games card, Top read card
top_defects.what: soft card shadows are clipped by the 390 px feed frame: hard vertical cut at the cards' left and right edges (x≈57 and x≈1233 px) instead of a shadow that spreads into the margins; grid column 0 meanDiff 6-11

top_defects.where: tab bar over the Top read card
top_defects.what: glass tab bar too opaque: the blurred 'Page de liste de Wikimédia' and the tinted rank-2 circle showing through it in the reference are almost invisible

top_defects.where: Top read rows and card text
top_defects.what: row 2 title clips at 'présidentie' vs 'présidentiell', row 3 description truncates at 'réalité m…' vs 'réalité mu…'; 1-3 px vertical drifts on rows and 'Community' segment

top_defects.where: Top read #3 thumbnail, Games card title
top_defects.what: Star Academy logo cropped/scaled differently (whole wordmark vs zoomed 'ar/ader' crop); calendar glyph a little larger and heavier than the reference
no shared color/text styles or variables (styled: 0): #202122, #72777d, #3366cc repeated as raw values; tab items not a component
'Spacer' frames (1×10, 1×20) used instead of padding/gap; row 2 title 488 px wide overflowing its 322 px text frame; 44 vectors all named 'Vector'

strengths: every element of the reference present with exact text, including status bar (23:11, silent, 39 %), 'Card hidden · Undo' and French content with accents
geometry very close: blocks within a few px across the whole feed, photos correctly cropped in 40 pt rounded thumbnails
Section header, Event row and Top read row built as components with instances; feed and cards in auto-layout
